jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production BACKGROUND LAYER for the landscape 16:9 CellDefense game selection UI (target 1600x900). Input image 1 is the EXISTING GAME'S ART LANGUAGE REFERENCE ONLY, not a layout to copy. Match friendly warm coral tissue, matte peach cell lobules, cream collagen, dark plum accents, crisp stepped pixel-brush clusters and restrained cyan highlights. This is a game menu backdrop, not a battle map.
COMPOSITION: opaque full canvas, calm ivory/very pale peach central field, with biological scenery confined to peripheral bands and especially the lower corners. Keep x=8–92%, y=5–92% very quiet, flat and LOW CONTRAST: this is where variable-count cards and headings will be placed later. Sparse larger cell forms, not lots of tiny nuclei. The backdrop must work with any number or placement of overlaid cards, including future pages. Do NOT paint empty card frames, slots, placeholders, buttons or label ribbons; those will be separate sprites.
STYLE: polished cute hand-painted PIXEL GAME art, clean clusters of visible square pixels, comfortable negative space, broad biological silhouettes, 3–4 shades per material. No blur, dither noise, watercolor, vector-flat UI, photoreal wet flesh, gore, pools of blood, sci-fi metal or fantasy architecture.
Absolutely NO TEXT, numbers, stars, locks, nodes, maps, path dots, arrows, icons, cards, units or enemies. NO baked title, chapter count or route. Only decorative background tissue. Keep the center light enough for dark plum lettering and cream cards with plum outlines.
CHAPTER 1 — WOUND DEFENSE. Evoke the existing outside-to-inside skin cross-section, simplified into a broad pale ivory upper field with a very thin gently undulating peach skin membrane at the bottom 12–16%. Friendly rose tissue and cream fibers curve up only in the far lower corners. A tiny clean wound cleft can appear at extreme lower-left, never in the content region. First chapter is the calmest and lightest. No descending progression track, fixed nodes, anatomy diagram, hand or arm.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: TRANSPARENT sprite atlas for the existing CellDefense pixel game UI. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only. Match the existing cream ivory faces, warm coral lower bevel, bold tidy dark plum stepped outline, and cyan selected accents. Cute hand-painted crisp pixel UI, not vector, no blur, no tiny texture noise, no metal. Every component is on real transparent alpha, with generous transparent gutters. No text, characters, numerals, labels, watermark or checkerboard pixels.
Canvas landscape 3:2, target 1536x1024. EXACTLY SIX SEPARATE components, one per equally sized cell in a strict THREE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid. Cell boundaries are imaginary; never draw a grid. Center each component within its own cell; nothing overlaps another cell.
TOP ROW left: one BLANK reusable rectangular CARD PANEL, width about 400 and height about 280 within its 512x512 cell. Soft chamfered pixel corners, 8–12px dark plum outline, ivory opaque flat blank center, coral lower bevel, tiny cream top edge. No thumbnail, slot, inset subdivisions, sockets or ornaments in its center. Keep border thickness modest. This panel will be nine-sliced into different card sizes.
TOP ROW middle: the SAME blank panel in HIGHLIGHTED state, same size and corner silhouette, cyan inner border and subtle teal/cyan lower bevel, ivory center. No glow rays or selected arrow.
TOP ROW right: one BLANK wide TITLE PLATE, about 420x110, cream with dark plum outline, coral lower bevel and tiny cyan underside accent. Absolutely no text.
BOTTOM ROW left: one SQUARE BACK BUTTON, about 150x130, cream/plum/coral base with one large golden LEFT ARROW icon at its center.
BOTTOM ROW middle: one SQUARE NEXT BUTTON, about 150x130, identical base with one large golden RIGHT ARROW icon at center.
BOTTOM ROW right: one BLANK small HORIZONTAL PILL LABEL, about 220x70, deep plum flat face, coral stepped outer edge and a tiny warm-ivory top highlight. No number or letter.
The surrounding canvas and all spaces BETWEEN components must be genuinely transparent. All six are separate production sprites, not a completed menu screenshot.
